title: Lack of Privilege Separation in Build Environments
pattern: Running user-defined build steps or compilation actions inside an environment that has direct read access to production signing keys or release credentials.
why_bad: Build systems allow "RCE by design" through arbitrary build script configurations (e.g., `Jenkinsfile`, `Makefile`, `build.rs`). If the build process has access to signing keys, any unreviewed dependency change can steal them.
detection: CI/CD runners executing user-defined compiling scripts with environment variables or directories exposed containing deployment keys or signing certificates.
fix: Isolate compilation tasks in a sand gapped container with zero network access and no access to signing keys; perform binary signing in a separate privileged orchestrator.
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 14, p. 323.
